text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — streaming latency alert (p99 spike) observed for /v1/stream SSE endpoints in eu-west-1. Thresholds breached: p95 320ms -> 800ms, p99 1.2s -> 4.8s. Affected customers: subset of live connections, high-tail dropouts.

oncall-anna: I'm on it. Where's the blast radius? any specific model or pool?

eng-runtime-jordan: early signal looks tied to proxy layer connections hitting TIME_WAIT bursts. We're seeing a backlog on the streaming proxy (envoy) to backends. Related logs: `envoy_streaming_write_timeout` increments.

eng-sre-maya: all metrics: connection count up ~30% for SSE streams from a handful of egress proxies. Keepalive traffic dropped? heartbeat mismatch in traces.

support-luke: got 3 customers on PagerDuty complaining of truncated streams and long pauses (~10-20s) before reconnect. One mentioned client-side retries triggering duplicate events.

oncall-anna: tagging @eng-runtime-jordan @eng-sre-maya. immediate ask: is this configuration or infra? impact on SLAs?

eng-runtime-jordan: running `kubectl -n platform logs -l app=stream-proxy --since=5m | grep timeout | tail -n 50` shows repeated: `E 2026-03-15T09:14:10Z proxy: write failed: broken pipe` then `W 2026-03-15T09:14:11Z stream: client-headroom exhausted, queuing`.

eng-sre-maya: envoy admin shows upstream pending requests hitting 95th percentile queue length. `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9901/stats | grep pending` => `cluster.backend_stream_upstream.pending_3xx: 0`, `cluster.backend_stream.pending: 42`. That's high.

eng-runtime-jordan: also seeing `SO_KEEPALIVE` churn after a recent rollout of keepalive tuning (PR #8423) that reduced keepalive interval. Suspect aggressive keepalive combined with client slow consumers is triggering perceived backpressure and then proxy gives up and times out.

product-aria: any customer-visible errors? 5xxs? errors in logs?

support-luke: 502 spikes correlate with the p99 latency windows. Customers see `connection reset` then clients re-open and get initial payload but miss a few chunks.

oncall-anna: immediate mitigation options? can we rollback the keepalive tuning? scale proxies? divert traffic?

eng-sre-maya: fastest: enable fallback routing to us-east-1 for affected customers (route-level) — reduces latency but is cross-region. Alternative: revert keepalive change on proxies (fast rolling restart) — but restarts will drop existing connections.

eng-runtime-jordan: another mitigation: reduce `downstream_flow_control_window` on envoy to avoid buffering huge backpressure and allow earlier TCP backpressure to propagate. That is a config change but needs rollout. Might be safer to temporarily bump proxy pool size by +20% to absorb queue.

oncall-anna: do we have a canary group or subset of customers to test mitigation?

support-luke: customer-poc (on this thread) is one of impacted — they can verify.

customer-poc: Confirming: we saw stalls around 09:13-09:16, had to reconnect 3 times. Happy to be switched to region fallback for testing.

eng-runtime-jordan: ok plan: 1) Turn on route fallback for affected customers to us-east-1 (non-disruptive). 2) Roll back keepalive tuning in next 10m if fallback doesn't help. 3) If still bad, scale proxy pool +20% and adjust flow-control.

oncall-anna: execute step 1 now. @eng-runtime-jordan can you trigger routing change? state the commands you run.

eng-runtime-jordan: running:```
# route service update
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/v1/routes/fallback" -d '{"route":"/v1/stream","from_region":"eu-west-1","to_region":"us-east-1","selector":{"customer_id":"affected-list"}}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN"
```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Route fallback API call accepted. rollout-id=rb-2026-03-15-09-18-01.

eng-sre-maya: monitoring now. metrics show egress to us-east-1 increasing for selector. p99 for eu-west-1 streams dropping from 4.8s -> 1.1s within 60s of rollout for impacted customers.

support-luke: customer-poc: can you confirm if playback improved post-fallback?

customer-poc: yes latency noticeably improved, reconnects stopped. still seeing a small jitter but much better.

product-aria: good. what's impact on unit economics? cross-region adds cost but preserves SLA. track for billing.

eng-runtime-jordan: next: preparing a rollback of keepalive tuning to revert PR #8423. Rolling restart will drop connections; propose to schedule in 30m and warn customers. Alternatively we can patch proxies with a hot config change to restore old keepalive without restart — checking feasibility.

eng-sre-maya: I can do hot config if we revert the specific flag. Running a dry-run on a canary proxy now: `curl -X POST http://admin.envoy/cfg_dump -d @revert-keepalive.json` -> successful, no restart required for that field.

oncall-anna: prefer hot config first. execute canary and monitor 10m, then roll to remainder.

eng-runtime-jordan: applying hot config to 2 canaries... done. monitoring traces. initial signs: connection churn reduced, `client-headroom` warnings dropped.

incident-bot: :bar_chart: Observability update: p95 eu-west-1 streaming latency down to 350ms, p99 at 950ms across affected customers. Error 502 rate cut by 70%.

support-luke: I'll update the support ticket queue and notify customers that we applied a config rollback and enabled regional fallback.

product-aria: owning postmortem and customer comms, will coordinate with eng for timeline and RCA.

eng-sre-maya: immediate RCA hypothesis: keepalive tuning + slow consumer clients -> proxy perceived dead connections -> aggressive timeouts -> queued backpressure -> large tail spikes. Need full trace correlation and kernel TCP metrics.

oncall-anna: action items: [ ] eng-runtime to prepare full revert PR and run load test, [ ] eng-sre to collect tcpdump+envoy stats for 09:10-09:20 window, [ ] product to draft comms, [ ] support to notify impacted customers and attach mitigation steps.

eng-runtime-jordan: logging the incident: INC-2026-1745. I'll attach logs and rollout IDs.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident created INC-2026-1745. Severity: Sev2. Linked runbook: streaming-backpressure.

oncall-anna: thanks all. keep updates here — if anything regresses, escalate to SEV1.

eng-sre-maya: one more note: long-term fix items: smarter stream-level throttling, explicit client slow-consumer signalling, and guardrails for keepalive config changes (staged canary + synthetic streaming tests).

support-luke: marking customers impacted for credits review.

product-aria: I'll add timeline and RCA draft by EOD.

customer-poc: thanks for quick action, appreciate the fallback.

oncall-anna: closing open mitigation tasks, monitoring for 30m. If stable, we'll transition to post-incident followup. :thumbsup:
